case.title: 胸部 X 线
case.artist: Benjamín Herreros, Isabel Plaza, Rebeca García, Marta Chichón, Carmen Guerrero and Emilio Pintor
case.teaching_note: 公开影像，用于胸部区位对照。
case.description_public:
Chest radiograph of miliary tuberculosis, 22 days after onset of fever, chills, and general malaise in a 82-year-old female. it shows extensive bilateral reticulo-nodular infiltrates
From the same case (edit):


		
			
			X-ray, 13 days after onset, showing bilateral interstitial infiltrates.

objective: 认识胸部的 5 个教学分区，并能把每个分区与库内征象词条对应起来。
